Hi Logan,

Thanks for taking this — attaching the proposed Order Form (Finteq_OrderForm_v1.pdf) and our preferred MSA excerpt. Procurement asked that we confirm the signing authority for Redwood (who signs on behalf of the company) and whether you’ll be using Redwood’s standard MSA or a redline to our MSA.

A few quick context points:
- This deal is for the pilot one-year seat license (approx. $120k ARR) — procurement will likely issue a PO after signature.
- Billing contact: jane.doyle@finteq.com (cc’d to procurement separately).
- We also attached a preliminary signature matrix (Finteq_SignatureMatrix.xlsx).

Can you confirm the point of contact on your side for legal redlines and an expected timeline for a first-pass redline? We’re hoping to start legal review this week to meet a mid-August start.

Thanks,
Alex Garner
Head of Business Ops | Finteq Solutions

Hi Alex — appreciate the packet. Quick notes and proposed next steps: 

1) Signing authority: can you confirm the signatory name/role for Finteq (we saw the matrix but want to ensure the right individual will receive DocuSign)?
2) Template preference: we can review either Redwood's MSA or your MSA. For speed, our standard approach is to run a first-pass redline against Redwood's MSA and, if you prefer to keep your MSA, we can produce a side-by-side comparison. Which do you prefer?
3) Timeline: Kimberly from Contracts will own the redline. I’ve asked her for a target first-pass in 48–72 hours once she has the final Order Form and explicit signatory.
4) Billing and PO: noted. If procurement will issue a PO, we’ll want the billing contact and PO reference included on the final Order Form.

Kimberly / Marissa — assigning this to contracts. Please see Alex’s attachments. Kimberly, can you confirm availability for a short sync (15 minutes) this afternoon to align on carve-outs/hosting terms?

Alex — looping in a doc link where we’ll drop redline notes after the sync.

Thanks,
Logan Wright
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
